evidence.why: Signature, scratch-register use and snapshot.
Startup preservation and invocation before debugger resources.
Interrupt gating and target snapshot before debugger context reload.

reason: No-frame parameterless save uses global output and scratch GPRs; startup and target interrupt entry preserve default context first, then invoke it before debugger takeover. Interrupt early returns and in-TRK exceptions do not invoke this saver.

Public assembly declarations.
